name: Sulphur Skyline
why: Straight up from Miette Hot Springs to a bald summit with ranges of grey limestone peaks in every direction, then down to soak in the pools.
book: No permit. Miette Road (17 km from the Yellowhead Highway) is closed in winter and at times for works: check Parks Canada before you go.
dangers: Steep loose scree on the summit cone.
Bighorn sheep and bears on the trail.

points.name: Miette Hot Springs
points.note: The hot pools at the end of Miette Road.

points.name: Sulphur Skyline summit
points.note: A bare summit at 2,070 m over the Fiddle River valley.
